file_change.purpose: Record governed semantic-review results for Design readiness, Planning sufficiency, and Build fidelity.
implementation: Define AssuranceFinding and AssuranceReport records with phase, subject identity, disposition, rationale, and evidence references.
Support design, planning, and build review phases.

Require Planning Assurance to explicitly address Design fidelity, functional-set coherence/manageability, normative distillation, semantic invention, file-scope completeness, implementation detail, invariants, validation, and executability.
Require Build Assurance to address Plan fidelity, Design-through-Plan fidelity, operational adequacy, material edge/failure behavior, unauthorized improvisation, and evidence sufficiency.
Do not mutate normative authority; findings route persistent meaning defects to Design and distillation/intent defects to Planning.
Require Design Assurance reports to address clarity, completeness, consistency, architecture/boundaries, ambiguity, omissions, alternatives/tradeoffs, risks, and blocking questions.

For FS0 bootstrap only, accept the pre-Build Planning Assurance decision as externally produced Governance evidence; the candidate runtime's planning-assure command validates capability for later functional sets and cannot self-authorize the Plan that creates it.
